objects.name: Analytic 1913
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an email client process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux workstation spawning a child process inconsistent with normal email handling. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
